Refines anime face geometry and 2K basecolor texture (closes right-brow bangs slit, sculpts +1.8mm 3D nose ridge, anchors full chin/jawline to Head, paints 3D-projected nose/smiling mouth/cheek blush/eyebrow & iris catchlights), caps the underarm seam with watertight 3-ring concentric torso & sleeve walls + smooth raglan armpit blending, replaces high-heeled boots with flat knit sock feet derived from Luna's foot template, binds all 115 bones with normalized max-4 weights, preserves Walk_Grounded_Loop and ChairSit_Contact clips, and authors sparse LeftArmContact/RightArmContact corrective shape keys via cycle-free proxy cloth simulation + cohesive 6.8-deg fleece cushion pivot + C-infinity separating-sheet solver (<=1.2cm local sleeve flattening). Matte fleece PBR (normalScale 0.20, metallicFactor 0, lifted 0.68-0.96 roughness, baseColor emissive 0.32); loaded on demand via wardrobe toggle or ?outfit=hoodie. See assets/models/resident/README.md. Postprocessed by scripts/finish-luna-cloud-hoodie.mjs for local flank clearance, blended armhole weights and sparse yawn shape keys. Blender pass scripts/refine-luna-hoodie-folds.py restores raised-arm flank ease, re-rounds the elbow in the sampled pose, relaxes fused hair-shoulder edges, and bakes local morph normals.
